blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) has released pay guidelines for two non-working days and one holiday for the month of November this year. Based on Proclamation No. 1006, November 1 and 2 are declared as special non-working days in line with All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, respectively. November
